yàn宴táo桃yuán园háo豪jié杰sān三jié结yì义·zhǎn斩huáng黄jīn巾yīng英xióng雄shǒu首lì立gōng功Feasting in the Peach Garden, Three Heroes Swear Brotherhood; Slaying the Yellow Turbans, a Hero Achieves His First Merit

天下大势黄巾起义桃园结义初战立功
huà话shuō说tiān天xià下dà大shì势，fēn分jiǔ久bì必hé合，hé合jiǔ久bì必fēn分。dōng东hàn汉mò末nián年，cháo朝tíng廷fǔ腐bài败，huáng皇dì帝ruǎn软ruò弱，wài外qī戚hé和huàn宦guān官lún轮liú流zhǎng掌quán权，bǎ把guó国jiā家gǎo搞de得yī一tuán团zāo糟。They say the great trends of the world must divide after long union and unite after long division. In the final years of the Eastern Han, the court was corrupt, the Emperor weak, and relatives of the empress and the eunuchs took turns seizing power, throwing the country into chaos.
jiā加shàng上lián连nián年tiān天zāi灾，liáng粮shí食qiàn歉shōu收，lǎo老bǎi百xìng姓chī吃bù不bǎo饱、chuān穿bù不nuǎn暖，gè各dì地yuàn怨shēng声zài载dào道。jiù就zài在zhè这yàng样de的nián年tóu头，jù巨lù鹿jùn郡chū出le了sān三gè个xiōng兄dì弟：zhāng张jiǎo角、zhāng张bǎo宝、zhāng张liáng梁。On top of that, years of natural disaster and poor harvests left the common people without enough food or warm clothing, and complaints could be heard everywhere. In such times, three brothers appeared in Julu Commandery: Zhang Jiao, Zhang Bao, and Zhang Liang.
zhāng张jiǎo角běn本shì是gè个luò落dì第de的xiù秀cái才，dǒng懂xiē些yī医shù术。tā他yòng用fú符shuǐ水gěi给rén人zhì治bìng病，zhì治hǎo好le了bù不shǎo少rén人，míng名shēng声yuè越lái来yuè越dà大。tā他zì自chēng称“dà大xián贤liáng良shī师”，dào到chù处shōu收tú徒dì弟，shì势lì力yī一tiān天bǐ比yī一tiān天dà大。Zhang Jiao had originally been a failed scholar who knew some medicine. He healed people with talisman water, curing quite a few, and his reputation grew. He called himself the "Great Worthy and Good Teacher," took disciples everywhere, and his following grew day by day.
hòu后lái来，zhāng张jiǎo角jù聚jí集le了jǐ几shí十wàn万rén人，hǎn喊chū出“cāng苍tiān天yǐ已sǐ死，huáng黄tiān天dāng当lì立”de的kǒu口hào号，fā发dòng动qǐ起yì义。yīn因wèi为tā他men们tóu头shàng上dōu都guǒ裹zhe着huáng黄jīn巾，suǒ所yǐ以rén人men们jiào叫tā他men们“huáng黄jīn巾jūn军”。Later, Zhang Jiao gathered hundreds of thousands of people and raised the slogan "The Blue Heaven is dead, the Yellow Heaven shall rise," launching an uprising. Because they wrapped yellow cloth around their heads, people called them the "Yellow Turban Army."
huáng黄jīn巾jūn军shēng声shì势hào浩dà大，guān官bīng兵lián连lián连dǎ打bài败zhàng仗，xiāo消xī息chuán传dào到jīng京chéng城，cháo朝tíng廷shàng上xià下huāng慌chéng成yī一tuán团。huáng皇dì帝gǎn赶jǐn紧xià下lìng令gè各dì地zhāo招bīng兵mǎi买mǎ马，jiā加qiáng强fáng防shǒu守。The Yellow Turbans grew so powerful that the government troops lost battle after battle, and when the news reached the capital, the court was thrown into a panic. The Emperor hastily ordered every region to recruit soldiers and buy horses to strengthen its defenses.
zhāo招bīng兵de的bǎng榜wén文tiē贴dào到le了yōu幽zhōu州zhuō涿xiàn县。jiē街shàng上yǒu有gè个qīng青nián年kàn看zhe着bǎng榜wén文cháng长cháng长tàn叹le了yī一kǒu口qì气。zhè这rén人xìng姓liú刘míng名bèi备，zì字xuán玄dé德，shì是hàn汉shì室de的yuǎn远fáng房qīn亲qī戚，jiā家dào道zhōng中luò落，kào靠mài卖cǎo草xié鞋hé和biān编xí席zi子guò过rì日zi子。The recruitment notice was posted in Zhuo County of Youzhou. On the street, a young man looked at the notice and gave a long sigh. This man was Liu Bei, courtesy name Xuande, a distant relative of the Han imperial house whose family had fallen on hard times; he made his living selling straw sandals and weaving mats.
liú刘bèi备shēn身hòu后hū忽rán然yǒu有rén人dà大hè喝yī一shēng声：“dà大zhàng丈fū夫bù不qù去wèi为guó国jiā家chū出lì力，zài在zhè这r儿tàn叹shén什me么qì气！”liú刘bèi备huí回tóu头yī一kàn看，zhǐ只jiàn见yī一gè个hēi黑liǎn脸dà大hàn汉，bào豹tóu头huán环yǎn眼，mǎn满liǎn脸hú胡xū须，shēng声yīn音xiàng像dǎ打léi雷yī一yàng样。cǐ此rén人xìng姓zhāng张míng名fēi飞，zì字yì翼dé德，shì是gè个mài卖jiǔ酒tú屠zhū猪de的，jiā家lǐ里yǒu有xiē些tián田chǎn产。Suddenly someone behind Liu Bei shouted: "If you're a real man, why not serve your country instead of sighing here?" Liu Bei turned and saw a big dark-faced man with a leopard's head, round eyes, and a full beard, whose voice boomed like thunder. This was Zhang Fei, courtesy name Yide, a butcher and wine seller who owned some farmland.
liǎng两rén人yuè越shuō说yuè越tóu投jī机，jiù就yī一qǐ起dào到jiǔ酒guǎn馆hē喝jiǔ酒。zhèng正hē喝zhe着，yòu又jìn进lái来yī一gè个dà大hàn汉，tuī推zhe着yī一liàng辆chē车zi子zài在mén门kǒu口xiē歇jiǎo脚。zhè这rén人shēn身cái材gāo高dà大，liǎn脸sè色fā发hóng红，liú留zhe着cháng长cháng长de的hú胡zi子，yī一kàn看jiù就bù不shì是pǔ普tōng通rén人。The two hit it off at once and went to a tavern to drink together. As they were drinking, another big man came in, pushing a cart and stopping at the door to rest. This man was tall and powerfully built, with a reddish face and a long beard—clearly no ordinary person.
cǐ此rén人xìng姓guān关míng名yǔ羽，zì字yún云cháng长，yīn因wèi为zài在jiā家xiāng乡shā杀le了è恶bà霸，táo逃chū出lái来yǐ已jīng经wǔ五liù六nián年le了。sān三gè个rén人yī一liáo聊，fā发xiàn现zhì志tóng同dào道hé合，dōu都xiǎng想gàn干yī一fān番dà大shì事。This man was Guan Yu, courtesy name Yunchang, who had fled his hometown five or six years earlier after killing a local bully. The three talked and found they shared the same ideals, all wanting to accomplish something great.
zhāng张fēi飞shuō说：“wǒ我jiā家hòu后miàn面yǒu有gè个táo桃yuán园，huā花kāi开de得zhèng正hǎo好。míng明tiān天zán咱men们jiù就zài在yuán园lǐ里jié结bài拜wéi为xiōng兄dì弟，qí齐xīn心xié协lì力，gòng共tú图dà大yè业。”liú刘bèi备hé和guān关yǔ羽dōu都zàn赞chéng成。Zhang Fei said: "There's a peach garden behind my house, and the flowers are in full bloom. Tomorrow let's swear brotherhood there, unite our hearts, and strive together for a great cause." Liu Bei and Guan Yu both agreed.
dì第èr二tiān天，táo桃yuán园lǐ里bǎi摆hǎo好le了xiāng香àn案、jì祭pǐn品。sān三gè个rén人guì跪xià下qǐ起shì誓：“niàn念liú刘bèi备、guān关yǔ羽、zhāng张fēi飞sān三rén人，suī虽rán然bù不shì是tóng同xìng姓，dàn但yuàn愿jié结wéi为yì异xìng姓xiōng兄dì弟，tóng同shēng生tóng同sǐ死，huàn患nàn难xiāng相fú扶。shàng上bào报guó国jiā家，xià下ān安bǎi百xìng姓。”The next day, an incense table and offerings were set up in the peach garden. The three knelt and swore: "We, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei, though of different surnames, wish to become brothers, sharing life and death and supporting each other in hardship. Above, we shall serve the country; below, we shall bring peace to the people."
shì誓bà罢，sān三rén人àn按nián年líng龄pái排le了zhǎng长yòu幼：liú刘bèi备wéi为dà大gē哥，guān关yǔ羽wéi为èr二gē哥，zhāng张fēi飞wéi为sān三dì弟。cóng从cǐ此，sān三rén人tóng同chī吃tóng同zhù住，xíng形yǐng影bù不lí离。After the oath, the three ranked themselves by age: Liu Bei as eldest brother, Guan Yu as second, and Zhang Fei as third. From then on they ate and lived together, inseparable as shadow and form.
sān三rén人zhāo招mù募le了wǔ五bǎi百duō多míng名xiāng乡yǒng勇，dài带zhe着duì队wǔ伍qù去tóu投bēn奔yōu幽zhōu州tài太shǒu守liú刘yān焉。liú刘yān焉jiàn见tā他men们lái来de得zhèng正shì是shí时hòu候，shí十fēn分gāo高xìng兴，dāng当chǎng场rèn认le了liú刘bèi备zuò做zhí侄r儿，ràng让tā他men们lǐng领bīng兵zuò作zhàn战。The three recruited over five hundred local volunteers and led them to join Liu Yan, the Governor of Youzhou. Liu Yan, seeing they had arrived at just the right moment, was delighted, recognized Liu Bei as his nephew on the spot, and had them lead troops into battle.
bù不jiǔ久，huáng黄jīn巾jūn军jiàng将lǐng领chéng程yuǎn远zhì志dài带bīng兵lái来gōng攻。liú刘bèi备shuài率lǐng领guān关yǔ羽、zhāng张fēi飞yíng迎zhàn战，sān三rén人chōng冲rù入dí敌zhèn阵，rú如rù入wú无rén人zhī之jìng境。zhāng张fēi飞yī一qiāng枪cì刺sǐ死le了chéng程yuǎn远zhì志，huáng黄jīn巾jūn军dà大bài败ér而táo逃。Before long, the Yellow Turban commander Cheng Yuanzhi brought troops to attack. Liu Bei led Guan Yu and Zhang Fei to meet them, and the three charged into the enemy ranks as if into an empty land. Zhang Fei ran Cheng Yuanzhi through with a single spear thrust, and the Yellow Turban army fled in defeat.
zhè这yī一zhàng仗dǎ打de得piào漂liàng亮，sān三rén人de的míng名shēng声hěn很kuài快chuán传kāi开le了。cǐ此hòu后，tā他men们gēn跟suí随guān官jūn军nán南zhēng征běi北zhàn战，lì立xià下bù不shǎo少gōng功láo劳，zhú逐jiàn渐chéng成wéi为yī一zhī支bù不kě可xiǎo小kàn看de的lì力liàng量。The battle was fought brilliantly, and the three men's reputation spread quickly. After that they followed the government army through many campaigns, won considerable merit, and gradually became a force not to be underestimated.

zhāng张yì翼dé德nù怒biān鞭dū督yóu邮·hé何guó国jiù舅móu谋shā杀huàn宦guān官Zhang Yide in Anger Whips the Inspector; Uncle He Plots the Death of the Eunuchs

鞭打督邮弃官出走宦官乱政何进被杀
huáng黄jīn巾jūn军bèi被píng平dìng定yǐ以hòu后，liú刘bèi备yīn因wèi为lì立le了gōng功，bèi被rèn任mìng命wéi为ān安xǐ喜xiàn县de的xiàn县wèi尉。guān官bù不dà大，dàn但zǒng总suàn算yǒu有le了gè个zhèng正jīng经chāi差shì事。liú刘bèi备dài带zhe着guān关yǔ羽、zhāng张fēi飞shàng上rèn任，chǔ处chù处xiǎo小xīn心jǐn谨shèn慎，duì对bǎi百xìng姓yě也hěn很kè客qì气。After the Yellow Turban Rebellion was put down, Liu Bei was appointed county defender of Anxi for his merits. It was not a high office, but at least it was a proper post. Liu Bei took Guan Yu and Zhang Fei with him to take up the position, acting cautiously in everything and treating the people kindly.
bù不liào料shàng上miàn面pài派le了yī一gè个dū督yóu邮lái来xún巡shì视。zhè这dū督yóu邮wéi为rén人tān贪lán婪，dào到le了ān安xǐ喜xiàn县jiù就shēn伸shǒu手yào要qián钱，xián嫌liú刘bèi备gěi给de得shǎo少，biàn便chù处chù处diāo刁nán难，hái还dāng当zhòng众xiū羞rǔ辱liú刘bèi备。Unexpectedly, a superior sent an inspector to review the county. This inspector was greedy; upon reaching Anxi County he stretched out his hand for money, and complaining that Liu Bei gave too little, he made trouble at every turn and even humiliated Liu Bei in public.
zhāng张fēi飞běn本lái来jiù就pí脾qì气huǒ火bào爆，tīng听shuō说dū督yóu邮qī欺fù负dà大gē哥，qì气de得zhí直tiào跳。tā他hē喝le了jǐ几wǎn碗mèn闷jiǔ酒，dài带zhe着jǐ几gè个shì士bīng兵chōng冲jìn进yì驿zhàn站，yī一bǎ把jiāng将dū督yóu邮cóng从chuáng床shàng上tuō拖le了xià下lái来。Zhang Fei was hot-tempered to begin with, and when he heard the inspector had bullied his elder brother, he was furious. After downing a few bowls of wine, he took some soldiers, stormed into the post station, and dragged the inspector right off his bed.
zhāng张fēi飞bǎ把dū督yóu邮bǎng绑zài在mén门wài外de的yī一kē棵liǔ柳shù树shàng上，zhé折xià下liǔ柳tiáo条jiù就wǎng往tā他shēn身shàng上chōu抽。yī一xià下xià下dǎ打de得yòu又hěn狠yòu又zhòng重，dū督yóu邮téng疼de得wā哇wā哇luàn乱jiào叫，lián连shēng声qiú求ráo饶。Zhang Fei bound the inspector to a willow tree outside the gate and broke off willow branches to lash him. Each blow was fierce and heavy, and the inspector screamed in pain and begged for mercy again and again.
liú刘bèi备tīng听dào到dòng动jìng静gǎn赶lái来，gǎn赶jǐn紧quàn劝zhāng张fēi飞zhù住shǒu手，yòu又tì替dū督yóu邮shuō说qíng情。kě可dū督yóu邮xīn心huái怀hèn恨yì意，fàng放huà话shuō说yī一dìng定yào要shàng上bào报bào报fù复。liú刘bèi备tàn叹le了kǒu口qì气，zhī知dào道zhè这guān官shì是zuò做bù不xià下qù去le了。Liu Bei heard the commotion, hurried over, and quickly urged Zhang Fei to stop, then pleaded on the inspector's behalf. But the inspector harbored a grudge and threatened to report them and take revenge. Liu Bei sighed, knowing this post could no longer be held.
dāng当tiān天yè夜lǐ里，liú刘bèi备dài带zhe着guān关yǔ羽、zhāng张fēi飞，bǎ把guān官yìn印guà挂zài在xiàn县yá衙dà大táng堂shàng上，qiāo悄qiāo悄lí离kāi开le了ān安xǐ喜xiàn县。sān三rén人yī一shí时méi没le了qù去chù处，zhǐ只hǎo好xiān先qù去tóu投bēn奔bié别de的dì地fāng方。That night, Liu Bei took Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, hung the official seal in the county hall, and quietly left Anxi County. With nowhere to go for the moment, the three had no choice but to seek refuge elsewhere.
zhè这shí时jīng京chéng城luò洛yáng阳lǐ里，cháo朝tíng廷de的zhēng争dòu斗yuè越lái来yuè越jī激liè烈。huáng皇dì帝nián年jì纪xiǎo小，bù不dǒng懂shì事，dà大quán权luò落zài在shí十gè个yǒu有míng名de的huàn宦guān官shǒu手lǐ里，rén人men们jiào叫tā他men们“shí十cháng常shì侍”。zhè这xiē些rén人gōu勾jié结qīn亲qī戚，tān贪wū污shòu受huì贿，bǎ把cháo朝zhèng政gǎo搞de得wū乌yān烟zhàng瘴qì气。At this time in the capital Luoyang, the struggles at court grew fiercer by the day. The Emperor was young and knew nothing of affairs, and real power fell into the hands of ten notorious eunuchs whom people called the "Ten Regular Attendants." These men colluded with their relatives, took bribes, and threw the government into utter chaos.
dà大jiàng将jūn军hé何jìn进shì是huáng皇dì帝de的jiù舅jiù舅，shǒu手lǐ里zhǎng掌wò握zhe着bīng兵quán权，zǎo早jiù就kàn看bù不guàn惯zhè这bāng帮huàn宦guān官。tā他hé和shǒu手xià下de的rén人shāng商liáng量，xiǎng想zhǎo找gè个jī机huì会bǎ把zhè这xiē些rén人yī一wǎng网dǎ打jìn尽。General He Jin was the Emperor's uncle by marriage and held military power in his hands; he had long been disgusted by these eunuchs. He discussed with his subordinates, hoping to find a chance to wipe them all out in one sweep.

Caught between them, Liu Bei's forces suffered heavy losses.
liú刘bèi备zǒu走tóu投wú无lù路，zhǐ只hǎo好zàn暂shí时zài在xiǎo小pèi沛luò落jiǎo脚，gēn跟lǚ吕bù布jiǎng讲hé和。lǚ吕bù布yě也bù不xiǎng想bǎ把shì事zuò做jué绝，jiù就dá答yìng应ràng让liú刘bèi备tún屯bīng兵xiǎo小pèi沛，liǎng两jiā家zàn暂shí时xiāng相ān安wú无shì事。With nowhere else to turn, Liu Bei had to settle temporarily at Xiaopei and make peace with Lü Bu. Lü Bu, not wanting to push things too far, agreed to let Liu Bei station his troops at Xiaopei, and the two sides kept a temporary peace.
liú刘bèi备xīn心lǐ里míng明bai白，xú徐zhōu州zhè这bǐ笔zhàng账chí迟zǎo早yào要suàn算，kě可yǎn眼xià下shí实lì力bù不gòu够，zhǐ只néng能xiān先rěn忍zhe着。Liu Bei understood in his heart that the score of Xuzhou would have to be settled sooner or later, but for now he lacked the strength and could only endure.
cáo曹cāo操zài在xǔ许dū都kàn看de得qīng清qīng清chǔ楚，liú刘bèi备hé和lǚ吕bù布zhè这liǎng两gè个rén人shuí谁yě也bù不fú服shuí谁，zhèng正hǎo好ràng让tā他men们hù互xiāng相qiān牵zhì制。yú于shì是tā他dǎ打zhe着huáng皇dì帝de的qí旗hào号，fēng封liú刘bèi备zuò做yù豫zhōu州mù牧，ràng让tā他qù去duì对fù付lǚ吕bù布。Cao Cao in Xudu saw all this clearly: Liu Bei and Lü Bu were each unwilling to submit to the other, so it suited him to have them check each other. So under the Emperor's authority he appointed Liu Bei as Governor of Yuzhou, setting him against Lü Bu.
liú刘bèi备jiē接le了rèn任mìng命，xīn心lǐ里yě也míng明bai白cáo曹cāo操shì是zài在lì利yòng用tā他，kě可yǒu有gè个zhèng正shì式míng名fèn分zǒng总bǐ比méi没yǒu有qiáng强。tā他gān干cuì脆jiè借zhè这gè个jī机huì会zhāo招bīng兵mǎi买mǎ马，zhuàng壮dà大zì自jǐ己。Liu Bei accepted the appointment, knowing full well Cao Cao was using him, but a proper title was better than none. He simply took the chance to recruit soldiers and buy horses, building up his own strength.
cáo曹cāo操zhè这biān边yě也méi没xián闲zhe着，yī一miàn面kàn看zhe着liú刘bèi备hé和lǚ吕bù布dòu斗，yī一miàn面zhěng整dùn顿bīng兵mǎ马，zhǔn准bèi备zhǎo找jī机huì会qīn亲zì自shōu收shí拾xú徐zhōu州。Cao Cao was not idle either; while watching Liu Bei and Lü Bu fight, he reorganized his own forces, preparing to seize Xuzhou himself when the chance came.
tiān天xià下de的jú局miàn面yuè越lái来yuè越qīng清chǔ楚：cáo曹cāo操zài在zhōng中yāng央xié挟zhe着huáng皇dì帝，gè各dì地de的zhū诸hóu侯hù互xiāng相zhēng争dòu斗，shuí谁de的quán拳tóu头yìng硬，shuí谁jiù就shuō说le了suàn算。The situation in the realm was growing clearer by the day: Cao Cao held the Emperor at the center, the regional lords fought among themselves, and whoever had the strongest fist had the final say.
第十五回

tài太shǐ史cí慈hān酣zhàn战xiǎo小bà霸wáng王·sūn孙bó伯fú符dà大zhàn战yán严bái白hǔ虎Taishi Ci Fights a Rousing Battle with the Little Tyrant; Sun Bofu Fights a Great Battle with White Tiger Yan

孙策借兵渡江起兵神亭之战收服太史慈
sūn孙jiān坚sǐ死hòu后，tā他de的dà大ér儿zi子sūn孙cè策dài带zhe着jiā家juàn眷tóu投bēn奔le了yuán袁shù术。sūn孙cè策nián年qīng轻yǒu有wéi为，dǎ打zhàng仗yǒng勇měng猛，yuán袁shù术shǒu手xià下de的rén人dōu都hěn很pèi佩fú服tā他，kě可yuán袁shù术běn本rén人què却shǐ始zhōng终bù不kěn肯zhòng重yòng用。After Sun Jian's death, his eldest son Sun Ce took the family and sought refuge with Yuan Shu. Sun Ce was young but capable and fierce in battle; Yuan Shu's men all admired him, yet Yuan Shu himself never gave him important command.
sūn孙cè策xīn心lǐ里biē憋zhe着yī一gǔ股qì气，xiǎng想qǐ起fù父qīn亲liú留xià下de的jiāng江dōng东jī基yè业hái还méi没yǒu有duó夺huí回，jiù就ná拿chū出chuán传guó国yù玉xǐ玺zuò做dǐ抵yā押，xiàng向yuán袁shù术jiè借le了jǐ几qiān千bīng兵mǎ马，zhǔn准bèi备huí回jiāng江dōng东chuǎng闯tiān天xià下。Sun Ce burned with frustration. Remembering that his father's Jiangdong legacy had yet to be reclaimed, he used the Imperial Seal as collateral to borrow a few thousand troops from Yuan Shu, preparing to return to Jiangdong and make his own way in the world.
yuán袁shù术běn本lái来jiù就yǎn眼chán馋nà那kuài块yù玉xǐ玺，jiàn见sūn孙cè策ná拿tā它lái来yā押，xīn心lǐ里lè乐kāi开le了huā花，dāng当chǎng场dá答yìng应jiè借bīng兵。tā他xīn心xiǎng想：“sūn孙cè策zhè这xiǎo小zi子nián年jì纪qīng轻，néng能chéng成shén什me么qì气hòu候！”Yuan Shu had long coveted the Imperial Seal. Seeing Sun Ce offer it as security, he was delighted and agreed on the spot to lend the troops. He thought to himself: "That young whelp Sun Ce can't amount to much!"
sūn孙cè策dài带zhe着jiè借lái来de的bīng兵mǎ马dù渡guò过dà大jiāng江，yī一lù路shàng上zhāo招bīng兵mǎi买mǎ马，xī吸shōu收rén人cái才。tā他nián年qīng轻qì气shèng盛，dǎ打qǐ起zhàng仗lái来bù不yào要mìng命，jiāng江dōng东de的háo豪jié杰fēn纷fēn纷lái来tóu投kào靠。Sun Ce crossed the great river with the borrowed troops, recruiting soldiers and buying horses along the way and gathering talent. Young and full of fire, he fought with reckless daring, and the heroes of Jiangdong came flocking to join him.
tā他xiān先dǎ打liú刘yáo繇，zài再dǎ打yán严bái白hǔ虎，jǐ几zhàng仗xià下lái来，míng名shēng声dà大zhèn振，rén人men们dōu都jiào叫tā他“xiǎo小bà霸wáng王”。gēn跟zhe着tā他de的rén人yuè越lái来yuè越duō多，duì队wǔ伍yuè越lái来yuè越zhuàng壮dà大。He first attacked Liu Yao, then White Tiger Yan. After several battles his reputation soared, and people called him the "Little Tyrant." More and more men followed him, and his forces grew steadily.
sūn孙cè策dǎ打dào到qū曲ā阿de的shí时hòu候，dāng当dì地de的háo豪qiáng强yán严bái白hǔ虎shuài率bīng兵yíng迎zhàn战。sūn孙cè策shǒu手xià下yǒu有gè个měng猛jiàng将jiào叫chéng程pǔ普，yī一mǎ马dāng当xiān先chōng冲jìn进dí敌zhèn阵，shā杀de得yán严bái白hǔ虎dà大bài败ér而táo逃。When Sun Ce reached Qu'a, the local strongman White Tiger Yan led troops against him. Sun Ce had a fierce general named Cheng Pu, who charged into the enemy ranks ahead of everyone and routed White Tiger Yan.
sūn孙cè策tīng听shuō说shén神tíng亭nà那biān边yǒu有dí敌jūn军，qīn亲zì自dài带zhe着jǐ几gè个qí骑bīng兵qù去zhēn侦chá察。qiǎo巧de的shì是，duì对fāng方de的tài太shǐ史cí慈yě也dài带zhe着jǐ几gè个rén人lái来zhè这r儿。liǎng两bō拨rén人zài在shén神tíng亭zhuàng撞shàng上le了。Hearing there were enemy troops near Shenting, Sun Ce went personally with a few horsemen to scout. As it happened, the enemy's Taishi Ci had also come to the same spot with a few men. The two parties ran into each other at Shenting.
tài太shǐ史cí慈yī一diǎn点bù不chù怵，tǐng挺qiāng枪jiù就shàng上。sūn孙cè策yě也bù不hán含hu糊，huī挥jiàn剑yíng迎zhàn战。liǎng两gè个rén人cóng从mǎ马shàng上dǎ打dào到mǎ马xià下，yòu又cóng从mǎ马xià下dǎ打mǎ马shàng上，yī一zhí直dǎ打le了jǐ几shí十huí回hé合，shuí谁yě也méi没yíng赢。Taishi Ci showed not a trace of fear and leveled his spear at once. Sun Ce met him without hesitation, sword in hand. The two fought from horseback to the ground and from the ground back onto horseback, trading dozens of bouts with neither gaining the upper hand.
dǎ打dào到hòu后lái来，sūn孙cè策yī一bǎ把zhuā抓zhù住tài太shǐ史cí慈de的duǎn短jǐ戟，tài太shǐ史cí慈yě也yī一bǎ把jiū揪zhù住sūn孙cè策de的tóu头kuī盔，liǎng两gè个rén人niǔ扭dǎ打zài在yī一qǐ起。zuì最hòu后liǎng两biān边de的yuán援bīng兵dōu都dào到le了，liǎng两rén人cái才sōng松shǒu手。zhè这yī一zhàng仗，liǎng两gè个rén人xīn心lǐ里dōu都pèi佩fú服duì对fāng方。Eventually Sun Ce grabbed Taishi Ci's short halberd, and Taishi Ci seized Sun Ce's helmet, and the two grappled hand to hand. Only when reinforcements arrived on both sides did they let go. After this battle, each man secretly admired the other.
hòu后lái来tài太shǐ史cí慈bīng兵bài败bèi被qín擒，yā押dào到sūn孙cè策miàn面qián前。dà大jiā家dōu都yǐ以wéi为sūn孙cè策huì会shā杀tā他，méi没xiǎng想dào到sūn孙cè策qīn亲zì自shàng上qián前jiě解kāi开shéng绳suǒ索，hái还bǎ把zì自jǐ己de的zhàn战páo袍pī披zài在tā他shēn身shàng上。Later Taishi Ci was defeated and captured and brought before Sun Ce. Everyone assumed Sun Ce would have him killed, but instead Sun Ce personally untied his ropes and draped his own battle cloak over his shoulders.
sūn孙cè策lā拉zhe着tài太shǐ史cí慈de的shǒu手shuō说：“shén神tíng亭nà那yī一zhàng仗，wǒ我jiù就zhī知dào道nǐ你shì是tiáo条hǎo好hàn汉。gēn跟wǒ我yī一qǐ起gàn干ba吧！”tài太shǐ史cí慈jiàn见tā他zhè这me么zhàng仗yì义，xīn心lǐ里gǎn感dòng动，dāng当chǎng场dá答yìng应guī归shùn顺。Sun Ce took Taishi Ci by the hand and said: "After that fight at Shenting, I knew you were a true man. Join me!" Seeing such honor and generosity, Taishi Ci was moved and agreed on the spot to submit to him.
cóng从cǐ此，sūn孙cè策shǒu手xià下yòu又duō多le了yī一yuán员měng猛jiàng将，jiāng江dōng东de的dì地pán盘yuè越dǎ打yuè越dà大。tā他nián年jì纪qīng轻qīng轻jiù就chuǎng闯chū出le了yī一piàn片tiān天dì地，chéng成wéi为jiāng江dōng东de的yī一fāng方bà霸zhǔ主。From then on Sun Ce had another fierce general at his side, and his Jiangdong territory grew ever larger. At a young age he had carved out a domain of his own and become the master of Jiangdong.
jiāng江dōng东de的jī基yè业jiù就zhè这yàng样yī一diǎn点yī一diǎn点dǎ打xià下lái来，hòu后lái来chuán传dào到tā他dì弟di弟sūn孙quán权shǒu手lǐ里，chéng成le了sān三guó国zhī之yī一de的wú吴guó国。The Jiangdong enterprise was built up bit by bit in this way. It later passed into the hands of his younger brother Sun Quan and became the state of Wu, one of the Three Kingdoms.
